topic: Mops database error fix and deployment
summary_markdown:
A recurring `DB::Exception: Substitution gf is not set` (Code: 456) error was discussed, observed in local sandbox and production logs. It was determined that a fix, which someone had previously worked on or intended to deploy as a hotfix, needs to be implemented.

The required change involves updating code located at `https://github.[redacted]` and must be deployed across all environments (beta and production).
decisions: Implement the fix for the Mops database error in the specified GitHub repository.
Deploy the hotfix to both beta and production environments.
action_items: Cherry-pick the required code changes into all relevant environments (beta and production).
